edition.sourceEdition: Macmillan, 1866 text as established by Project Gutenberg eBook #11

positioning.description: Alice follows a hurrying rabbit out of a dull afternoon and into a world with no rules she recognises. Everyone she meets is certain she is the strange one. Working out who she is turns out to be the only way home.

sections.synopsis: A dull riverbank, a rabbit with a waistcoat and a pocket watch, and a fall that goes on long enough to get bored in. Alice lands in a hall of locked doors.
Alice changes size twice, cries a pool, and then has to swim it alongside a mouse who objects to her conversation.
